why_ru: Вводный оборот Frankly speaking — откровенно говоря.

prompt: If you two have had a misunderstanding, sit down over a cup of tea and ___ it out.
why_ru: Фразовый глагол talk sth out — обсудить проблему до конца и уладить её.

prompt: The hotel room was tiny and noisy — disappointing, to ___ the least.
why_ru: Идиома to say the least — мягко говоря.

prompt: When the junior clerk was unfairly blamed for the error, only one colleague dared to ___ up for him.
why_ru: Фразовый глагол speak up for sb — вступиться за кого-то.

prompt: The ferry was cancelled because of the storm. Needless to ___, we missed our connecting train in Dover.
why_ru: Вводное выражение Needless to say — излишне говорить, разумеется.

prompt: The new software has a few bugs. Having ___ that, it is still much faster than the old system.
why_ru: Вводный оборот Having said that — и всё же, тем не менее.

prompt: Few employees were brave enough to ___ out against the company's decision to cut overtime pay.
why_ru: Фразовый глагол speak out (against sth) — открыто выступить против.

prompt: Repairing the flooded basement will cost thousands of pounds, to ___ nothing of the ruined furniture.
why_ru: Идиома to say nothing of… — не говоря уже о…
